risks.title: Commodity price volatility (oil, gas)
risks.summary: The company's results are highly sensitive to fluctuations in oil and gas prices. Although hedging strategies are in place, significant price variations can negatively impact cash flows.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors (Item 1A), with direct language regarding financial results sensitivity. The company uses hedges but a $10/bbl change can have a significant financial impact (up to $294 million reduction in proceeds). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Counterparty credit risk
risks.summary: The company faces risk that its commercial partners or financial instrument counterparties fail to meet their obligations, potentially leading to financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a significant risk in Item 1A, affecting trade receivables and derivative instruments. The company monitors exposure but counterparty default may result in losses. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition from renewable energy
risks.summary: Competition from alternative energy sources such as solar and wind is intensifying, threatening demand for the company's oil and gas products.
risks.score_rationale: Identified in Item 1A, this risk is considered increasing due to technological advances and environmental policies. Competition is direct for electricity and indirect for hydrocarbons. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Oil and gas reserves estimation
risks.summary: Estimating proved oil and gas reserves is complex and subject to expert judgment, which may affect the accuracy of depreciation charges and asset values.
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a Critical Audit Matter in the audit report (Item 8), highlighting the complexity and subjectivity of required judgments. Reserve estimates directly impact depreciation expense. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Post-acquisition integration (Berry Corporation)
risks.summary: The recent acquisition of Berry Corporation (closed December 18, 2025) involves a complex fair value assessment of assets, presenting risks related to integration and accurate valuation of acquired assets.
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Berry Corporation is mentioned as a Critical Audit Matter (Item 8) regarding the fair value assessment of acquired assets. Integration and post-acquisition valuation present challenges. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest rate risk (debt)
risks.summary: Although the company has fixed-rate debt, future changes in interest rates could affect the cost of its long-term financing.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A, but the company has no variable-rate debt, limiting immediate risk. The risk is therefore moderate for now. (default score, to be refined)
